title: エキサイティングお嬢様

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and I are on our way back to the academy after finishing some errands, when…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have a favor I would like to ask of you today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well… Before, we talked about how I enjoy films, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want you to come out with me today as well, but for something different. Wh-what I meant to say is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahh, I can't bring myself to say it! Would you just accompany me for now?
choice_data_list: Of course, I'd be happy to.
Of course, I'd be happy to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a smile and a nod, I agree to go along with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Here we are. The truth is… this is a place I adore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No. Although I certainly wish it were as endearing an interest as that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's the place next to the amusement park that I like, not the park itself…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Can you hear it? The sound of cheering?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A round of cheers resonates from the nearby domed stadium. In other words…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes! I love to watch baseball. Particularly, I love watching games at the stadium.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: When I watch from behind home plate, I become so shamefully invigorated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes… I begin screaming, "Go, Yutaka!" and the like. Before I know it, my tail begins swishing out of control.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm fully aware this kind of behavior is unbecoming of a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Still, when I see my favorite team, the Victories, in an intense game, I… Ahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm… not. I suddenly feel overwhelmed with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I can't contain myself any longer. Please, Trainer! Come watch the game with me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I knew you would say that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Very well, then. Let's head into the stadium. Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen immediately takes my hand and breaks into a run. She seems really happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew… That was truly exciting! Um…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you were surprised just now. My behavior during the game was so unlike me.
choice_data_list: You sure like spinning your towel in the air!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The thrill just somehow takes control. I get all this strength and I can shout right from my diaphragm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Next time… I'd like you to cheer along with me. It's embarrassing to do it by myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I love doing that! I feel like a little kid, twirling it round and round.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'd like you to do it too. I'll teach you how, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: At any rate… this was nice. I never thought someone would agree to watch a baseball game with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Being able to share the joy of victory with someone as we walk home together is something I've only ever dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I took a chance and invited you.
choice_data_list: Hey, we're batterymates, you and I.
Hey, we're batterymates, you and I.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Batterymates? You're saying we're pitcher and catcher?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Indeed, you're right. We're in sync with each other in this figurative game of catch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But since you've said it, I don't want you to forget. If we're batterymates, that means we're playing for the same team.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want you to accept any secret I choose to share. Even my most shameful ones.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she says this, Mejiro McQueen averts her eyes just a little. There must be some things she isn't yet able to share.
